Run the entomological model across multiple parameter sets

Source: R/interventions.R
run_interventions.Rd

Fully vectorised runner: evaluates the entomological model for every combination of intervention parameter set, coverage value, and (optionally) vector parameter draw. All param_sets × coverage combinations are evaluated in a single matrix call to eval_entomological_model() per timepoint per draw, avoiding per-row R loop overhead and scaling efficiently to tens of thousands of parameter sets.

Two model structures are supported and are mutually exclusive. The model is auto-detected from param_sets:

  • Standard (3-host): no killing_during_host_seeking_absolute column (or all values NA). Uses deterrency, preprandial, postprandial.

  • Dummy-host (4-host): killing_during_host_seeking_absolute column present with at least one non-NA value. Uses deterrency, killing_during_host_seeking_absolute, postprandial. preprandial must be 0 for all rows.

Usage

run_interventions(
  param_sets,
  model_p,
  coverage_vec,
  vec_param_sets = NULL,
  interv_param_sets = NULL,
  exposure_sets = NULL,
  coverage_sets = NULL,
  duration_years = 3,
  insecticide_decay = TRUE,
  exposure = 1,
  keep_time = FALSE
)

Arguments

param_sets

Data frame where each row defines one parameter set. Required columns:

  • deterrency: initial deterrency efficacy in [0,1]

  • preprandial: initial pre-prandial killing efficacy in [0,1] (set to 0 for the dummy-host model)

  • postprandial: initial post-prandial killing efficacy in [0,1]

  • halflife_attrition: attrition decay parameter L (days): half-life for Weibull / exponential / Hill, time to zero for linear / step / smooth-compact (the column can be omitted when every row has decay_attrition = "none")

  • shape_attrition: attrition decay shape parameter (required for Weibull / Hill / smooth-compact; NA or omitted otherwise)

  • decay_attrition: decay shape string (see decay_function())

Optional columns:

  • name: label of the parameter set (used by plot_impact()); any other column is also carried to the output.

  • killing_during_host_seeking_absolute: activates the dummy-host (4-host) model; absolute availability of the dummy host (see KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute in build_intervention()). Non-missing values must be finite and non-negative; NA means inactive.

  • halflife_det, halflife_pre, halflife_post, halflife_hsk: per-component linear insecticide decay (years); despite the name, the time at which the effect reaches zero (see halflife_insecticide in build_intervention()). halflife_hsk applies to killing_during_host_seeking_absolute in dummy-host mode.

  • decay_det, L_det, kappa_det (and equivalently _pre, _post, _hsk): general per-component decay function, L (days; meaning depends on the shape, see decay_function()), and shape. _hsk controls the decay of killing_during_host_seeking_absolute. Overrides the corresponding halflife_* column whenever a shape is specified. Constant shapes need no L_* or kappa_*; other shapes require their parameters (incomplete specifications raise an error).

model_p

Model object from build_model_obj().

coverage_vec

Non-empty numeric vector of finite deployment coverages in [0,1]. Coverage 0 is used internally as the no-intervention baseline for computing avg_impact; it is added automatically if not present, and the corresponding row is included in the output only when explicitly supplied.

vec_param_sets

Optional data frame of vector parameter draws (same columns as vec_ent_param). Each row is one draw. Adds a draw column to the output.

interv_param_sets

Optional data frame with n_draw rows and the same columns as param_sets. Row d replaces param_sets for draw d. A list of n_draw single-row data frames is also accepted for backward compatibility.

exposure_sets

Optional numeric vector (or list) of n_draw exposure factors; each replaces exposure for that draw, e.g. to propagate uncertainty in activity patterns via calculate_exposure().

coverage_sets

Optional list of n_draw coverage vectors; each replaces coverage_vec for that draw.

duration_years

Single finite positive duration in years (one time point per day, with at least one point). Default 3 years.

insecticide_decay

Logical (default TRUE). If FALSE, the per-component insecticide decay columns (halflife_*, decay_*, L_*, kappa_*) are ignored: efficacies keep their initial (e.g. unwashed) values and only attrition decays.

exposure

Proportion of human exposure to bites that occurs where the intervention protects, in [0, 1] (default 1). The intervention acts on an effective coverage coverage * exposure. Typically calculate_exposure(...)$Exposure_Indoor_whileinbed for ITNs, and $indoor_resting or $Exposure_Indoor_total for IRS (see calculate_exposure).

keep_time

Logical (default FALSE): also return the vectorial capacity and impact on each day (memory-heavy for large sweeps).

Value

A data.table with one row per (parameter set × coverage [× draw]). All columns of param_sets are included; when vec_param_sets is supplied the draw-specific vector parameter columns are appended. Output columns coverage (deployment coverage), exposure, avg_vc, avg_impact, and (when any uncertainty source is supplied) draw follow.

With keep_time = TRUE, a list with this table as impact and a long data.table time with columns param_set (row of param_sets), name (if param_sets has one), coverage, day (0 = deployment), vc, impact and, with uncertainty draws, draw.
